reading.title: Reading length and mass units
reading.text: Dina measures a small box. She uses a ruler for a short edge and a tape measure for a longer one. The note gives one length in millimeters and a journey in kilometers. A yard is a different length unit. The small sample's mass is in milligrams. Dina reads the unit with each number. She does not compare two measurements until she knows what their units mean.
